turns.replyTail: ithin 2–3 business days, and you'll receive a tracking email as soon as your package ships. Once shipped, delivery typically takes 4–10 business days depending on your location.If your order includes multiple items, they might ship separately, and you'll get individual tracking numbers for each shipment. If you log into your account, you can see your current month's box status at the top of your homepage.If you have any other questions or need help tracking your specific order, just let me know!

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail: your tracking link in two ways:Check your email inbox for a shipping confirmation from Bark—this email will include your tracking link.Log in to your Bark account at bark.co. Once logged in, you'll see your current month's box status and tracking information at the top of your homepage. You can also view your order history and tracking details by going to the Manage Subscription page: https://bark.co/apps/subscriptions/manage/.If you need help finding a specific tracking link, just let me know!
